actual_usl_source:
// Build accounting from observed reports; these calculations award no semantics.
let data = workload_inputs()
assert data["catalog_original_entries"] == 606
let source_profiles = 0
let function_profiles = 0
for mode in data["profile_modes"]:
    if mode == "closed_source_subset":
        source_profiles += 1
    else:
        assert mode == "function_fragment"
        function_profiles += 1
let scoped_profiles = source_profiles + function_profiles
let logical_partial_jobs = data["total_entries"] * 4
let original_ids_without_any_typed_profile = 606 - scoped_profiles
let original_ids_without_closed_source_profile = 606 - source_profiles
let original_ids_without_native_subset_evidence = 606 - data["native_subset_union"]
let normative_language_obligations = 606 * data["obligation_dimensions"]
let admitted_workers = min(data["requested_workers"], max(1, int(data["cpu_effective"])))
assert logical_partial_jobs == data["observed_partial_jobs"]
assert admitted_workers == data["observed_physical_workers"]
assert scoped_profiles <= data["catalog_original_entries"]
assert data["fresh_native_executions"] == 2 * data["fresh_differentials"]
print("closed source profiles", source_profiles)
print("native function profiles", function_profiles)
print("remaining without any typed profile", original_ids_without_any_typed_profile)
print("remaining without native subset evidence", original_ids_without_native_subset_evidence)
print("normative obligations retained", normative_language_obligations)
print("resource-admitted workers", admitted_workers)
